name: Residente Temporal Inversionista

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum investment of USD 200,000 in businesses, real property, vehicles, or securities (or USD 100,000+ in forestry/reforestation projects), fully documented and authenticated.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying investment.

requirements.blocker_text: Investor status holders may not perform remunerated work (manual or intellectual) in Costa Rica.

requirement_groups.name: Special attraction regime (Ley 9996, reduced threshold + tax benefits)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum investment of USD 150,000 in real estate, securities, shares, national-interest or productive projects, venture capital funds, or sustainable infrastructure projects, registered personally (not via a legal entity, for real property). In exchange, grants duty-free import of household goods and a vehicle, and up to 20% exemption on property transfer taxes -- but ONLY within the law's benefits window (reported as the first 5 years after the regulation's 2023 publication, i.e. roughly through early-to-mid 2028; not independently reconfirmed as still open as of this research date).
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying investment before the benefits window closes.

requirements.blocker_text: Investor status holders and dependents may not perform remunerated work (manual or intellectual) in Costa Rica.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying investment (real estate title, share certificates, fund statements, etc.)

sources.title: Navas & Navas -- Categorías Migratorias summary (general investor category under Ley 8764)
Consortium Legal -- Reglamento de la Ley 9996 (special investor attraction regime, quoting the regulation directly)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. TWO GENUINELY DIFFERENT LEGAL BASES modelled as OR-logic groups for the same underlying 'Investor' migratory status: the long-standing general category under the base migration law (USD 200,000, Article 79) and a separate, later, TIME-LIMITED special attraction regime under Ley 9996 (USD 150,000, plus real tax/customs benefits, but explicitly reported as available 'únicamente durante los primeros 5 años' of the regulation, published Feb 2023). STATUS SET TO DRAFT for two reasons: (1) migracion.go.cr's and pgrweb.go.cr's own texts were not reachable in this pass (403 / robots-blocked), so neither figure is tier-1 confirmed; (2) the Ley 9996 benefits window's exact closing date could not be confirmed, and this research is being done in August 2026, plausibly at or past that window -- an applicant should verify the special regime is still open before relying on the 150,000/tax-benefit terms; the 200,000 general category should still apply regardless. This is exactly the kind of time-sensitive detail this dataset is meant to flag rather than silently assume.
